title: Recurring accrual, prepaid amortization and depreciation entries for the close
prompt: Prepare and propose all approved-policy recurring accrual, prepaid amortization and depreciation entries for the close period.

setup.q: Which recurring entries are approved (name, accounts, amount or source schedule, posting day)?
Which accruals reverse on the first day of the next month and which stay?

inputs.name: Journal entries already posted for the month

steps: read the period-lock state for the month being closed
pull the recurring schedules, the prepaid monthly amortization and the fixed asset monthly depreciation, and the journals already posted for the month
run duplicate_pairs between the entries due and the postings already made (same accounts, amount and month) so nothing is posted twice
propose the recurring entries from recurringSchedule (tier A) and the depreciation run (tier A); reversals follow reversalSettings
write the workbook listing each entry proposed, each skipped as already posted, and each schedule item with no source amount

done.text: Every proposed entry balances to the penny
No proposal repeats an entry already posted for the month or another proposal (same vendor or schedule, amount and period)
Every exception row cites the schedule line and the existing journal id where one was found
close-recurring-entries.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Only entries on the approved schedule are proposed; a schedule item with no source amount is a question, not an estimate; a closed period stops the proposals

tierRules.when: the entry is on the approved recurring schedule with its amount from the schedule or the Dime workpaper
the month's depreciation equals the fixed asset workpaper monthly summary
